skill.name: data-analysis
skill.description: Guides AI-assisted analysis of Empathy Ledger transcripts, themes, quotes, summaries, recommendations, and Supabase analytics patterns.
skill.summary: Reusable data analysis patterns for Empathy Ledger story and transcript features.
skill.author: Acurioustractor

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, TypeScript template literals, field names such as key_quotes, and localhost example commands. I did not find malware or prompt-injection text embedded in the skill files. Semantic review found privacy and AI safety risks around raw transcript model calls and batch analysis operations.

remediation.issue: Raw transcript content is sent to a third-party AI model in the analysis pattern.
remediation.suggestion: Add consent checks, redaction, tenant isolation, retention guidance, and opt-out handling before any external AI processing.

remediation.issue: The transcript analysis prompt embeds untrusted transcript text before parsing model output.
remediation.suggestion: Separate instructions from transcript content, tell the model to ignore instructions inside transcripts, validate against a strict schema, and handle parse failures safely.

remediation.issue: Batch sync and AI analysis commands can alter stored analysis data and consume quota.
remediation.suggestion: Make dry-run the default, document production safeguards, require explicit confirmation, and add quota and tenant scope checks.

semantic_findings.title: Raw Transcript Disclosure to Third-Party AI Service
semantic_findings.description: The analysis pattern sends transcript content directly to an Anthropic model. The guidance does not show consent checks, redaction, tenant controls, or data retention limits for sensitive interview material.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code constructs an Anthropic request with transcript.transcript_content embedded in the prompt. The surrounding documentation presents interview and cultural analysis use cases, making privacy controls important.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Transcript Prompt Injection Risk
semantic_findings.description: The transcript text is interpolated into the model prompt and the response is parsed as structured analysis. The example lacks isolation, instruction hierarchy, schema validation, and handling for malicious transcript instructions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The prompt includes raw transcript content immediately before output instructions and then parses the model response. This is a common prompt injection surface for AI analysis pipelines.

semantic_findings.title: Batch Analysis Commands Can Mutate Data and Consume Quota
semantic_findings.description: The sync status guide includes commands for full syncs, quote updates, and batch AI analysis. Without clear environment and confirmation safeguards, these commands can update stored data or consume AI quota unexpectedly.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The commands include full sync and batch analysis modes, including non-dry-run examples. The file also notes OpenAI quota limits, which supports the operational impact.

content.value_statement: Story platforms need consistent themes, quotes, and summaries across many views. This skill gives reusable patterns for transcript analysis, Supabase queries, and story recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Defines theme extraction structures for transcript and story records.
Shows quote selection and quote display patterns for story interfaces.
Provides Supabase query examples for themes, search, analytics, and batching.
Documents related story recommendation logic based on shared themes.
Lists API and component integration points for analysis features.
limitations: The files are guidance documents, not a complete runnable application.
AI model calls require separate privacy, consent, and retention controls.
Database examples must be adapted to the actual schema and access rules.
Batch analysis commands can affect costs and stored analysis results.

use_cases.title: Standardize Story Metadata
use_cases.description: Define consistent themes, key quotes, summaries, and analysis fields for published stories.

use_cases.title: Build Analysis Queries
use_cases.description: Create Supabase queries for theme matching, quote search, and analytics dashboards.

use_cases.title: Connect Insights to UI
use_cases.description: Map analysis fields into story cards, theme badges, quote galleries, and recommendation panels.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Theme Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an existing analysis flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the data-analysis skill to review my transcript theme pipeline. Identify missing fields, inconsistent theme names, and simple fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Add Quote Display
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the data-analysis skill to add featured quote display to story cards. Include source fields, fallback behavior, and display rules.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Analysis Queries
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the data-analysis skill to optimize Supabase queries for theme matching and quote search. Include indexes, filters, and pagination guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Analysis Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the data-analysis skill to design an end-to-end transcript analysis workflow. Cover ingestion, AI extraction, storage, UI use, privacy, and monitoring.

output_examples.input: A team wants story cards to show themes and one quote.
output_examples.output: The response recommends the featured quote source, fallback order, theme badge display, and empty-state behavior.

output_examples.input: A developer needs related stories for a selected story.
output_examples.output: The response explains theme overlap scoring, shared theme reasons, tenant filtering, and result limits.

output_examples.input: A data lead needs a dashboard for analysis coverage.
output_examples.output: The response lists metrics for processed transcripts, theme counts, quote coverage, pending analysis, and sync status.

best_practices: Normalize theme names before storing or comparing analysis results.
Limit query results and filter by tenant, status, and access permissions.
Review transcript privacy requirements before sending content to AI services.
anti_patterns: Do not treat AI output as trusted without validation and fallback handling.
Do not run batch analysis commands against production data without confirmation.
Do not display quotes without checking consent, attribution, and visibility rules.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build transcript analysis, theme extraction, quote display, search, analytics, and story recommendation features.

faq.question: Does the skill run analysis by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation patterns and examples that a developer can adapt in an application.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include database guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Supabase examples for arrays, full-text search, analytics views, indexes, and batch updates.

faq.question: What privacy controls are needed?
faq.answer: Teams should confirm consent, redact sensitive data, limit retention, and control third-party AI processing.

faq.question: Can it be used outside Empathy Ledger?
faq.answer: Yes, but table names, theme categories, UI components, and access rules need adaptation.
